summary: Busy day for on-chain packs. Crypto.com launched its own rips (Pokémon and sports packs from $5), BOXED launched a mobile rip app, and analysts posted weekly numbers showing Collector Crypt and Courtyard pack volume down week over week. We got one real Solflare Packs win post (an Elite pull from a Pokémon Starter Pack) plus a few small mentions, all positive or neutral. On the mainstream side, Delta Reign restock stress and scalper anger are the main collector pain points today.

top_posts.text: Yesterday, made some money from DLMM and a small spot trade, so I thought I'd treat myself to a little fun and bought a @solflare Pokemon Starter Pack. AND I HIT AN ELITE 🔥 ...
top_posts.why_it_matters: Organic user win post for Solflare Packs. Good to engage, but don't reuse its price-jump framing.

top_posts.text: the gacha market volume is down, while new giant steps in. - @Collector_Crypt 7d revenue: $1.49m, down 49% week over week - @Courtyard_io: $437k, down 17% - @phygitals still net negative after buybacks Yesterday @cryptocom launched rips: - pokemon + sports packs from $5 ...
top_posts.why_it_matters: Crypto.com entering packs is a big new rival with mainstream reach and card rails. Category volume cooling.

top_posts.text: It's finally here! The BOXED app is live on iOS and Android. Rip Pokémon, One Piece, MTG, Riftbound, sports cards, and more.
top_posts.why_it_matters: New app-store native rip app aimed at mainstream collectors. Same audience we want with Coinflow.

top_posts.text: For now crypto is cooked… trenches are cooked so I'll try my luck with Pokémon cards on PayBox. Elite Pokémon Gacha Pack is $50 USDC ...
top_posts.why_it_matters: Crypto traders rotating into Pokémon packs as 'fun' spend. High reply count; shows the crypto-native buyer mindset.

top_posts.text: Ever wondered what you can get for $25 in digital collectibles? I explored Collector Crypt on @PayBox and went hunting for the 5 cheapest trading card packs currently available.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Budget-pack explainer format from a creator. Easy format to copy for Solflare Packs.

top_posts.text: In the 30 days to Oct 19, Collector Crypt sold $166M of packs. Courtyard's machines recorded about $61M of pulls. It bids more to buy back a pulled card than Courtyard or Fanatics, pays USDC where Fanatics pays store credit, and lets partner storefronts sell its packs.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Research account framing USDC buyback and partner storefronts (like ours) as Collector Crypt's edge.

top_posts.text: Today on Top Shot 🗓️ At 3 PM ET, the Rookie Debut drop opens to everyone. It's the 2026 rookie class on Top Shot, with signed Rookie Debut /5s and Rookie Ultimate 1/1s hiding in the packs.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Top Shot running tiered drops (box/case) with per-collector limits.

top_posts.text: 23 of 25 Supernovas never made it into packs 😳🌌 Topps admitted the production error Sunday: only Judge and Soto Supernovas are actually in 2026 Cosmic Chrome.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Trust issue with physical pack contents. Shown odds and verifiable pulls are a real contrast.

top_posts.text: I work at a Target store in the area, and at the electronics counter we sell Pokemon cards. Every morning the same people line up before we open. Today we had special edition boxes that were $250. Sold out in fifteen minutes.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Clear first-hand sold-out/scalper pain. Good hook for mainstream collectors.
